children: ChargePoint reported second quarter fiscal 2027 revenue of $116.1 million, an 18% increase year-over-year, with GAAP gross margin of 36% and non-GAAP gross margin of 38%. The company recorded a GAAP net loss of $35.6 million and a non-GAAP adjusted EBITDA loss of $4.8 million, a substantial improvement from the year-ago period. ChargePoint ended the quarter with $95.7 million in cash, cash equivalents and restricted cash and approximately 27 million common shares outstanding.
Revenue: $116.1 million for the quarter (up 18% vs. prior-year quarter).
Gross profit: GAAP gross margin 36%; non-GAAP gross margin 38% (includes a 4 percentage-point benefit from tariff refunds).
Operating income: Loss from operations (GAAP) of $34.1 million for the quarter.
Net income/loss: GAAP net loss of $35.6 million for the quarter; non-GAAP net loss of $9.2 million for the quarter.
Non-GAAP adjusted EBITDA loss: $4.8 million for the quarter, improved from a $22.1 million loss in the prior-year quarter.
Product shipments: Began early access shipments of Express Solo, advancing the rollout of new fast-charging hardware.
Partnerships and commercial agreements: Continued expansion of partnership with Eaton and extended charging solutions agreement with Mercedes‑Benz for UK and Germany fleet customers.
Customer deployments: Announced agreements to add hundreds of new charging ports with Optimus Energy Solutions and Onvo in the eastern U.S.
Infrastructure deployment: Launched an overhead fast charging solution with Portland International Airport featuring retractable cable management designed for airport environments.
Leadership and market expansion: Appointed John Saffrett as Executive Vice President and Managing Director for Europe to lead growth and market expansion across the continent.

title: ChargePoint Reports Q2 FY2027 Revenue Up 18% to $116.1M, Non-GAAP EBITDA Loss Narrows to $4.8M
